user.title: Network Scanner
user.description: Scan one or more IP ranges with nmap and list the devices that answer. nmap needs root or the CAP_NET_RAW capability to read MAC addresses.

data_description.ip_range: One or more nmap targets separated by spaces, e.g. `192.168.1.0/24` or `192.168.1.1-254 10.0.0.0/24`.
data_description.mac_mappings: One device per line: `mac;name;manufacturer`. The manufacturer is optional. Lines starting with `#` are ignored.

error.invalid_ip_range: Enter at least one nmap target such as `192.168.1.0/24` or `192.168.1.1-254`.
error.invalid_mac_mappings: Line {line} is not a valid mapping. Use `aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff;Name;Manufacturer`.
error.nmap_unavailable: The nmap binary could not be found or executed. Install nmap where Home Assistant runs.

abort.already_configured: This IP range is already configured.

init.title: Network Scanner options
init.description: Changes take effect immediately; the integration reloads and runs a fresh scan.
